title: Pacini identifies the cholera bacterium
summary: Italian anatomist Filippo Pacini isolated the cholera bacterium Vibrio cholerae in 1854.
why: Identified the germ behind one of history's deadliest epidemics.

unsung.contribution: First isolated and described the cholera bacterium, Vibrio cholerae.
unsung.recognition: Koch was widely credited 30 years later; the formal name Vibrio cholerae Pacini 1854 honoured him only in 1965.
